definitions.explanation: Attaches directly to a noun, a counter phrase, or the dictionary form of a verb, and marks something that happens with each member of a set or at each repetition: {駅|えき}ごとに (at every station), {会|あ}うごとに (every time we meet). Also written {毎|ごと}に.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三時間|さんじかん}→三時間：30478_sanjikan⟧ごとに⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I take the medicine every three hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ごとに⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧になっていく。
examples.english: Every time I see him he seems healthier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧ごとに⟦{乗客|じょうきゃく}→乗客：03284_joukyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|お}りて→降りる：00568_oriru⟧いき、⟦{車内|しゃない}→車内：06203_shanai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧しだい⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧になった。
examples.english: Passengers got off at each station, and the train gradually grew quiet.

notes:
Distributive: it picks out every member of a set, one after another, without skipping any.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧ごとに: every year, at one-year intervals
- {人|ひと}ごとに⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: to differ from person to person
- {日|ひ}ごとに⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to grow colder day by day

COMMON MISTAKE — ごとに vs おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧:
おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ means "skipping one in between," so the two are easy to confuse:
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧ごとに = every day (each and every one)
- ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ = every other day (one day on, one day off)
